issue.title: Pin or bound Textual for .[dev] so CI shards stop drifting from workspace venvs
issue.description:
Decide between pinning/bounding Textual for .[dev] and having `just install` upgrade already-installed deps.

The fast shards resolve the newest Textual (8.2.8) from unpinned `textual[syntax]>=0.45.0`, while agent workspace venvs keep 8.0.1 and only the `visual` extra pins 8.0.1. Result: CI-only failures agents cannot reproduce locally (Master Gate root cause 4, 202609/fix_master_gate_ci.md: tests/ace/tui/command_line/test_chrome_layout.py failed 9/9 sampled CI runs, passed locally, because the recompose-wait helpers were vacuous under 8.2.x layout timing). The test was hardened to converge under both versions, but the drift remains for the next behavioral delta.

Related but distinct: sase-vr (lint toolchain from uv.lock) covers ruff/mypy determinism, not the Textual dev/CI split or install-upgrade semantics.
